verdict.rationale: Otter documents in-product AI insights across several features. Otter AI Chat answers natural-language questions across meetings and connected apps, and summaries extract decisions, action items and role-specific insights. It also offers real-time coaching prompts, sentiment and keyword monitoring, pre-meeting briefings and auto-generated follow-ups. All of this evidence is vendor marketing, and the only hands-on report about generated summaries calls one an inaccurate outline. That is a single anecdote, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality and accuracy of AI Chat answers and generated insights.
